name: Riedel silos
artist: Sfhir, Eleman, Klaas Lageweg, Karski and Beyond
notes: Paint-only extracts from the Street Art Cities photograph of the completed September 2018 festival. The east-to-west order is frog and reptiles, hand, rainbow paint, owl. Reviewed supporting oblique views to separate neighboring tanks and trim. The two east tanks replace a rectangular BAG approximation. The atlas unwraps the visible cylindrical arc with fitted seam angles. It masks the ladder, guardrail, annexes, bare cladding and paint outside the four modeled cylinders. Unseen rear arcs, lower paint behind the guardrail and mounting details remain unverified. Rim elevations come from AHN DSM samples. Exposed ground and plinth mount heights are estimated.

name: Kappa Docie train mural
notes: Paint only from the finished 2025 Atlas van Ede 360-degree panorama, reprojected to the west BAG wall. The installation finished on 6 June. The panorama was published on 16 June. The yellow fascia, glass, door frames, air conditioner, pavement and what is hidden behind the air conditioner are excluded. Opening proportions also come from the panorama. No imagery is placed on side walls.
